title: 私を支えるたくさんの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I become aware of a Satono Diamond G1 victory celebration in town.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I happen upon Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black, and they inform me that the venue is connected to the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an effort to contribute, Satono Diamond says she'll be passing out commemorative gifts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to go with her. Along the way, I learn that every Satono Group location is holding a party.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's very clear how much joy Satono Diamond's victory has brought her family.
